const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Interactive controller for the limited-mode RoboWits water_into_mug episode.
+
+Run with: python -u -i /app/output/gen.py
+The live Robot instance remains available as ``r`` in the Python prompt.
+"""
+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path('/app/runs')
+OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+r = Robot(timeout=3600)
+spec = r.spec()
+print('CONNECTED', r.base)
+print(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+
+def observe(name='obs'):
+    global obs
+    obs = r.get_obs(video='none')
+    d = OUT / name
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(d / f'{cam}.jpg', quality=95)
+    print('saved', d, 'meta=', obs.meta)
+    print('proprio layout=', obs.meta['proprio']['layout'])
+    print('proprio now=', np.round(obs.meta['proprio']['now'], 4).tolist())
+    return obs
+
+def submit_pose(rows, name='action', video='mp4'):
+    global res
+    res = r.submit('ee_pose', np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32), video=video, note=name)
+    print('result', res.meta)
+    d = OUT / name
+    res.save(str(d))
+    print('saved', d)
+    return res
+
+def submit_joints(rows, dt=0.1, name='action', video='mp4'):
+    global res
+    res = r.submit('joint_position', np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32), dt=dt, video=video, note=name)
+    print('result', res.meta)
+    d = OUT / name
+    res.save(str(d))
+    print('saved', d)
+    return res
+
+def current_pose():
+    p = np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)
+    # Proprio layout ends with right EE pose (xyz, qwxyz, width), then left EE pose.
+    layout = obs.meta['proprio']['layout']
+    return p, layout
+
+print('Use observe() to capture the current view. Robot is ready as r.')
*** End Patch";
const r = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(r);
